rows.note: Use this all-purpose word for a person or situation that causes trouble or is difficult to deal with.

example.english: This customer is always causing trouble; they’re really fractious.
example.traditional: 呢個客人成日搞事，真係好麻煩。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 haak3 jan4 seng4 jat6 gaau2 si6 zan1 hai6 hou2 maa4 faan4

rows.note: Choose this when the person is mainly irritable or quick-tempered rather than argumentative.

example.english: They’ve been under a lot of stress lately and keep losing their temper for no reason; they’re really fractious.
example.traditional: 佢最近壓力好大，成日無端端發脾氣，真係好暴躁。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 aat3 lik6 hou2 daai6 seng4 jat6 mou4 dyun1 dyun1 faat3 pei4 hei3 zan1 hai6 hou2 bou6 cou3

rows.note: Choose this when the person is argumentative, stubborn, or inclined to quarrel.

example.english: That kid argues whenever things don’t go their way; they’re really fractious.
example.traditional: 個細路一唔順意就同人拗，真係好拗頸。
example.jyutping: go3 sai3 lou6 jat1 m4 seon6 ji3 zau6 tung4 jan4 aau3 zan1 hai6 hou2 aau3 geng2
